name: Webhook
description: Generic HTTP webhook channel for QwenPaw. Accepts arbitrary JSON payloads via POST with optional HMAC-SHA256 signature verification, and posts agent replies to a configured outbound URL.

description_i18n.zh-CN: QwenPaw 的通用 HTTP Webhook 通道：接收任意 JSON 请求（可选 HMAC-SHA256 签名校验），并将 Agent 回复 POST 到配置的出站 URL。
description_i18n.en-US: Generic HTTP webhook channel for QwenPaw. Accepts arbitrary JSON payloads via POST with optional HMAC-SHA256 signature verification, and posts agent replies to a configured outbound URL.
